abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Transform into an invulnerable fast-moving orb that is invisible to enemies.

upgrades.effect: When leaving Vanish, you are invulnerable to damage for 1 second

abilities.name: Petal Dance
abilities.description: Heals you and your teammates over time.

abilities.name: Twisting Thorn
abilities.description: A lunging stab that Pierces your target.

abilities.name: Blade Barrier
abilities.description: Surround yourself with knives. Each blade damages on impact.

abilities.name: Creative Outburst
abilities.description: A shriek that pushes enemies away.

abilities.name: More the Merrier
abilities.description: Increase your damage based on the number of nearby enemies.

upgrades.effect: Damage Amplification increased to 20% per nearby enemy

abilities.name: Startling Lunge
abilities.description: Throw a hook at on enemy or object, pulling yourself towards them.

upgrades.effect: After a successful lunge, you are invulnerable to damage for 1 second

abilities.name: Irresistible Pull
abilities.description: Launch both claws towards a target and pull them back to you.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.description: Grants an additional health bar that negates piercing and crushing damage.

abilities.name: Northern Wind
abilities.description: An aura that slows the movement of enemies.

abilities.name: Icebreaker
abilities.description: A cone of ice that slows and damages enemies.

upgrades.effect: Enemies in the center of the cone are rooted in place for 1.5 seconds

abilities.name: Pragmatic Slashes
abilities.description: Final slash has extended range and slows the target.

abilities.name: Krurian Handshake
abilities.description: Thrust forward and pierce your target.

abilities.name: Shadowsmoke
abilities.description: A cloud of smoke that makes you and your teammates invisible. Attacking reveals you.

upgrades.effect: You and your teammates gain 1.5 seconds of invisibility when leaving smoke.

abilities.name: Stalking
abilities.description: Become Stealthed. After a brief period, your damage is increased.

abilities.name: Piercing Shot
abilities.description: A bolt that pierces your target when fired at long range.

abilities.name: Unload
abilities.description: A close-range burst of damage that pushes you and your enemies apart.

abilities.name: Embedding Throw
abilities.description: A ranged weapon that can embed in enemies or the environment.

abilities.name: Take Flight
abilities.description: Teleport to your ringblade.

abilities.name: Gloomy Groundlings
abilities.description: Summon Gloomies that attack nearby enemies and heal you and your teammates.

abilities.name: Mark the Outcast
abilities.description: Mark an enemy, causing them to take increased damage. Damage dealt to the marked target is shared with their nearby allies.

upgrades.effect: Marked opponent shares up to 100% of damage with nearby teammates

abilities.name: Ground Shark
abilities.description: Ranged attack. Burrows under obstacles and can pass through multiple enemies.

abilities.name: Gloomy Trap
abilities.description: Root enemies in the targeted area.

abilities.name: Dav's Darts
abilities.description: Ranged attack that fires in a burst.

abilities.name: Wall
abilities.description: Create a destructible wall.

abilities.name: Radiant Shield
abilities.description: Enter an invulnerable state. Exiting creates a lifestealing explosion.

upgrades.effect: Damage dealt on Radiant Shield exit now heals for 100%

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Sanctify an area. While inside it, all teammates are Steadfast.

upgrades.effect: Last strike of Joyous Pummelling area of effect increased

abilities.name: Righteous Swing
abilities.description: A two-handed swing that knocks enemies back.

abilities.name: Divine Thrust
abilities.description: A spear stab that can pierce through enemy armor when charged.

upgrades.effect: Reach of Divine Thrust increased when charged

abilities.name: Reflect
abilities.description: Reflect projectiles and block melee damage.

abilities.name: Forgefire
abilities.description: Place a protective totem that gives you and your teammates damage mitigation.

abilities.name: Flamepath
abilities.description: Summon a path of fire.

abilities.name: Strike the Anvil
abilities.description: Final swing is a ground slam that sets the target on fire.

abilities.name: Ember Toss
abilities.description: A lobbed projectile that explodes and catches enemies on fire.

upgrades.effect: Ember Toss lingers on the ground for 3 seconds

abilities.name: Searing Blast
abilities.description: A wave of flame that passes through targets and sets them on fire.

upgrades.effect: Searing Blast explodes when the wave passes through a target

abilities.name: Blinding Roar
abilities.description: A battlecry that blinds nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Vortex
abilities.description: A vortex that pulls enemies to its center, stunning them on impact.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Sweeping two-handed chops.

abilities.name: Savage Leap
abilities.description: Jump into the air and over obstacles. Slam down with crushing force.

abilities.name: Fury Punches
abilities.description: Light-footed punching combination.

abilities.name: Sadistic Throw
abilities.description: Grab a nearby enemy and hurl them away.

upgrades.effect: Throwing an opponent marks them and they take an additional 25% more damage for 5 seconds

abilities.name: Payback
abilities.description: Enemies take damage when they attack you. This ability does not reduce or negate incoming damage.

abilities.name: Audacity
abilities.description: Increase damage dealt and become vulnerable.

abilities.name: Shattering Sphere
abilities.description: A slow moving projectile that explodes on impact.

abilities.name: Ruinous Downfall
abilities.description: Slow all enemies in the targeted area.

upgrades.effect: Ruinous Downfall slow duration increased to 3 seconds

abilities.name: The Pillars
abilities.description: Create 3 destructible stalagmites.

abilities.name: Oscillating Regeneration
abilities.description: Create a portal. Casting again returns to the portal and heals you.

abilities.name: Voltaic Barrier
abilities.description: A barrier that blocks enemy projectiles and allows teammates to shoot through it.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: Hold to damage a single nearby target. DPS increases the longer a target is shocked.

abilities.name: Static Turret
abilities.description: A stationary turret that targets the closest enemy.

upgrades.effect: Static Turret detonates (30 damage) when destroyed or after 8 seconds

abilities.name: Particle Shot
abilities.description: Charged shots push targets back and stun.

abilities.name: Chain Reaction
abilities.description: A projectile that bounces between targets.

upgrades.effect: Chain Reaction will bounce up to 8 times between targets.

abilities.name: Sparkle
abilities.description: A projectile that bursts and forms a hazy bubble. Enemies inside the bubble are blinded.

abilities.name: Lock the Door
abilities.description: A sparkling wave that tethers enemies in place. The tether can be broken by straining against it.

abilities.name: Flying Shards
abilities.description: A ranged attack that can embed in enemies or the environment. Hitting an enemy will reduce cooldown time for Light Up the Sky.

abilities.name: Light Up the Sky
abilities.description: Detonate your Flying Shards.

abilities.name: Sharp Burst
abilities.description: Ranged attack. Short range. Fires 10 shards in a cone shaped burst.

abilities.name: Under the Weather
abilities.description: A directional dodge with an invulnerable state. Reloads the Parasol.

abilities.name: Yah'towa
abilities.description: Summon a companion to fight beside you. He will chase pinged targets.

abilities.name: Run Free
abilities.description: Surge forward, damaging enemies that you pass through.

abilities.name: Make Them Prey
abilities.description: A cone shaped attack that makes enemy attacks less effective.

abilities.name: Boom-Crack
abilities.description: A ranged attack that can be charged to explode on hit.

abilities.name: Bind
abilities.description: A ranged attack that Binds the target, limiting their ability to sprint or dodge.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.description: Recover your Health over time. Damage does not interrupt recovery.

abilities.name: Repair
abilities.description: Recover your Fortitude over time. Damage will interrupt recovery.

abilities.name: Reset
abilities.description: Refresh the cooldowns of Weapon Abilities, Stamina, and Endurance

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.description: Reduce incoming damage.

abilities.name: Elusive
abilities.description: Become Steadfast and increase movement speed.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.description: A cascade of projectiles that deal damage in a straight line.

abilities.name: Clusterbomb
abilities.description: Explosive orbs that form a triangle and then detonate.

abilities.name: Invulnerable
abilities.description: Become immune to damage.

abilities.name: Slide
abilities.description: Slide along the ground. Pass beneath projectiles. This ability does not interrupt sprinting.

abilities.name: Block & Bash
abilities.description: Raise your shield to block damage. Attack while blocking to bash. Blocking or bashing degrades shield HP.

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.description: Barrel forward, dealing damage and knocking back enemies in your path.

abilities.name: Charging Slam
abilities.description: Rush forward and slam down with a crushing blow.

abilities.name: Bow Shot
abilities.description: Fire a single arrow.

abilities.name: Wave Shot
abilities.description: Fire a wave of force that hits every target in its path.

abilities.name: Whirling Slash
abilities.description: A forward spinning attack that exhausts your target.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Throw a spinning projectile.

abilities.name: Snare Toss
abilities.description: Throw two merged shurikens that slow your target.

name: Healing Ward
description: A destructible ward that heals Health and Fortitude over time in a small Area of Effect.

name: Last Wish
description: If you are knocked down while this ability is active, you become Phased and Revive with 100 health. Lasts 7 seconds.

name: Mending Hands
description: Damage dealt to you is converted into healing. Lasts 2 seconds and Silences your abilities.

name: Summon Shrine
description: Summon a shrine. Your team can purchase items and resurrect fallen allies here. Lasts 30 seconds.

name: Full Heal
description: Channel for 2.5 seconds to heal yourself to full.

name: Self Revive
description: Channel for 2 seconds when knocked down to pick yourself back up with 100 health.

name: Refill Consumables
description: Refill your supply of consumables. If you have no consumables, Health Potions are the default.
